title: Small Business Valuation Multiples (<$1M SDE)
rules: Small owner-operated businesses are priced on SDE (Seller's Discretionary Earnings), NEVER on gross revenue.
Specialized assets with high recurring contracts (self-storage, waste management): 4.0x - 7.0x.
Rule: If the owner IS the business and operations stop when they leave, apply a 30-50% discount or walk.
